title: Connect AI Chat to Planning Agent

summary.goal: Replace mock AI chat responses with real conversations to the planning agent via relay messaging
summary.context: The UI has a chat panel (useAIChat hook) that currently returns mock responses. With relay integration, chat messages should be sent to the active planning agent, and agent responses displayed in the UI. The agent can respond with suggestions that trigger MCP tool calls.

acceptance_criteria.description: Chat messages routed to planning agent via relay
Agent responses displayed in chat UI
Agent can suggest plan changes in chat
User can approve/reject agent suggestions
Falls back to mock when no active session
UI indicates 'AI Connected' vs 'Demo Mode'

steps.title: Add chat API endpoint
steps.description: Create POST /plans/:id/chat endpoint. Accepts message, routes to planning agent via relay, returns agent response.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /plans/:id/chat accepts { message: string, context?: object }
Message forwarded to active planning agent via relay
Returns { response: string, suggestions?: Suggestion[], session_status: 'active' | 'none' }
Returns 400 if no active session for plan

steps.title: Implement relay message routing
steps.description: Update src/relay/chat.ts sendToAgent() to use real relay messaging. Currently stubbed with mock responses. Use RelayClient.sendMessage() to send to agent, set up onMessage callback to receive response, correlate via thread ID.

acceptance_criteria.description: Use client.sendMessage(agentId, message, 'chat', data, threadId) to send message
Set up client.onMessage callback to receive agent response
Correlate request/response using thread ID (unique per chat message)
Awaits response with configurable timeout (default 60s)
Timeout returns { error: 'TIMEOUT', partial_response?: string }
Remove mock response fallback in connected mode

steps.title: Define suggestion protocol
steps.description: Define how agent structures suggestions in responses. Agent wraps suggestions in structured format that can be parsed by chat endpoint.

acceptance_criteria.description: Suggestion type: { type: 'add_step' | 'edit_step' | 'remove_step' | ..., data: object, description: string }
Agent response can contain 0+ suggestions alongside text
Plain text responses work unchanged
System prompt (rpa001) includes suggestion format instructions

steps.title: Update UI chat API client
steps.description: Modify packages/planner-ui/src/api/chat.ts to call real endpoint instead of returning mock. Keep mock fallback when session_status is 'none'.

acceptance_criteria.description: sendChatMessage(planId, message) calls POST /plans/:id/chat
Response parsed into ChatResponse type matching existing UI types
Falls back to mock response when endpoint returns session_status='none'

steps.title: Create useAIConnectionStatus hook
steps.description: Create shared hook that checks session status via GET /plans/:id/session. Used by both chat and improvements to show 'AI Connected' vs 'Demo Mode'.

acceptance_criteria.description: useAIConnectionStatus(planId) returns { isConnected: boolean, status: 'connected' | 'demo' | 'loading' }
Polls session status every 10s while plan is open
Hook exported for reuse by relay-ai-improvements

steps.title: Update useAIChat hook
steps.description: Modify hook to use useAIConnectionStatus. Show connection indicator in chat panel.

acceptance_criteria.description: Chat panel shows 'AI Connected' badge when session active
Chat panel shows 'Demo Mode' badge when no session
Badge updates when session status changes

steps.title: Add suggestion confirmation UI
steps.description: When agent suggests a change, show confirmation UI. User can approve (applies via MCP) or reject (discards).

acceptance_criteria.description: Suggestions rendered as actionable cards in chat
Approve button calls appropriate API to apply change
Reject button dismisses suggestion
Applied suggestions show success indicator

steps.title: Extract reusable plan modification functions from MCP handlers
steps.description: Refactor MCP tool handlers (handleAddStep, handleEditStep, handleRemoveStep, handleAddCriteria) to separate core logic into reusable functions. These functions should be callable by both MCP handlers and HTTP endpoints without duplication. Create src/domain/plan-operations.ts with functions: addStepToPlan, editStepInPlan, removeStepFromPlan, addCriteriaToStep, editCriteriaInStep.

acceptance_criteria.description: addStepToPlan(storage, planId, stepData, expectedVersion?) creates new version with added step
editStepInPlan(storage, planId, stepId, updates, expectedVersion?) creates new version with modified step
removeStepFromPlan(storage, planId, stepId, expectedVersion?) creates new version with step removed
addCriteriaToStep(storage, planId, stepId, criteriaData, expectedVersion?) adds acceptance criterion
editCriteriaInStep(storage, planId, stepId, criteriaId, updates, expectedVersion?) modifies existing criterion
MCP handlers updated to call these shared functions
Functions return { success: true, version } or { success: false, error, code }

steps.title: Complete suggestion application endpoint implementation
steps.description: Replace TODO stubs in src/api/handlers/chat.ts applySuggestion handler (lines 234-266) with real implementations. Use the shared plan modification functions from rac010 to apply add_step, edit_step, remove_step, add_criteria, and edit_criteria suggestions. Ensure proper error handling and version conflict detection.

acceptance_criteria.description: add_step suggestion calls addStepToPlan and creates new version
edit_step suggestion calls editStepInPlan and creates new version
remove_step suggestion calls removeStepFromPlan and creates new version
add_criteria suggestion calls addCriteriaToStep and creates new version
edit_criteria suggestion calls editCriteriaInStep and creates new version
Returns { success: true, version, step? } with updated plan version
Returns 409 Conflict if version has changed (optimistic locking)
Agent notified of change via relay message (optional, if session active)

steps.title: Add tests for chat integration
steps.description: Test chat flow: message routing, suggestion parsing, UI updates, mock fallback. Also test shared plan modification functions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests for chat endpoint with mocked relay
Tests for suggestion parsing
Tests for suggestion application via applySuggestion endpoint
Tests for timeout handling
Tests for shared plan modification functions (addStepToPlan, etc.)
Tests for optimistic locking in suggestion application

plan_tests.notes: Focused on critical paths: shared plan modification functions (rac010), suggestion application, and error handling. MCP tools already have extensive coverage in tools.test.ts.

cases.rationale: New shared functions used by both MCP handlers and HTTP endpoints - must be tested independently

tests.description: addStepToPlan creates new version with step added
editStepInPlan creates new version with step fields updated
removeStepFromPlan creates new version without step, cleans dependencies
Returns VERSION_CONFLICT when expectedVersion doesn't match
Returns error when plan/step not found
Returns error when version is not draft
